question.text: Will Alibaba make a non-preview Qwen4 model available on a pay-as-you-go API basis before November 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, as of 23:59 UTC on November 27, 2026, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's model inference pricing documentation lists at least one Qwen4 model with standard pay-as-you-go input and output prices, either on the international documentation (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing) or on the China documentation (https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/model-pricing). A "Qwen4 model" is a Qwen4-series model whose model ID does not contain the string "preview" (for example qwen4-max, qwen4-plus, qwen4-flash, or qwen-4-max); a model whose ID contains "preview" never counts, even if prices are published for it. Access restricted to the Token Plan subscription, to an invite-only or waitlist scheme, or to the consumer Qwen app does not count as pay-as-you-go API availability. The question resolves No if no such model is listed, unless [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) report that Alibaba made a non-preview Qwen4 model available on a standard pay-as-you-go API basis before November 28, 2026, in which case it resolves Yes.
question.fine_print: Only Alibaba's own published model IDs count; listings on third-party aggregators or resellers (for example OpenRouter or AIHubMix) do not. A listing in any region or deployment scope counts (for example Singapore, US (Virginia), or China (Beijing)), and the currency in which prices are published (USD or CNY) is irrelevant. A new preview model, an extension of the Qwen4-Max-Preview period, or a dated snapshot of a preview model ID does not count, nor does publication of open weights without a corresponding pay-as-you-go model listing.

research:
On the evidence found, this question already looks settled as Yes, well before the November 27 deadline. As of November 16, 2026, both pricing pages named in the resolution criteria list a non-preview **qwen4-max** model with standard pay-as-you-go input and output prices.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: The international pricing page ("Last Updated: Nov 16, 2026") now has **qwen4-max** as the first row of the Qwen-Max table. In Singapore (International scope, thinking and non-thinking modes, up to 1M tokens) it costs **$1.5 per million input tokens and $4.5 per million output tokens**, with a free quota of 1 million tokens. In China (Beijing) it costs $1.413 / $4.24. There are also cache prices (write $1.875 or $3, read $0.075) and a batch price row. qwen3.8-max is still listed at $2 / $6. [Alibaba Cloud pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing)
- 2026-11-16: The China pricing page lists **qwen4-max** in China (Beijing) at **CNY 10 input / CNY 30 output** per million tokens, with a free quota of 1 million tokens. qwen3.8-max is CNY 12 / 36. [help.aliyun.com pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/model-pricing)
- The model ID "qwen4-max" does not contain "preview", so it is a non-preview Qwen4 model under the criteria.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-16: The page I fetched gave no sign that qwen4-max is limited to Token Plan, invite-only or "coming soon". I searched the pricing page for those notes and found none.
- 2026-11-16: A dedicated model page, "Qwen4-Max" ("Last Updated: Nov 16, 2026"), lists China (Beijing) and Singapore deployments, the OpenAI, Anthropic and DashScope APIs, and links to the pricing page for prices. [qwen4-max doc](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen4-max)
- 2026-11-16: The "Recommended models" page ("Last Updated: Nov 16, 2026") now shows qwen4-max first for text generation and visual understanding. [Models](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/models)
- The qwen4-max-preview page still says Token Plan only, no pay-as-you-go, retired after Nov 25. That rule covers only the preview ID. [preview doc](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen4-max-preview)
- One caveat: I could not test API calls. The only thing that could undo this is Alibaba removing the listing before Nov 27, 23:59 UTC.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: ChainCatcher reports that Alibaba released Qwen4-Max with cut API prices. Citing The Defiant, it says Singapore list prices are 25% below Qwen3.8-Max (consistent with $1.5 vs $2), that access now goes beyond the subscription preview, and that a smaller open-weight model is planned. [ChainCatcher](https://www.chaincatcher.com/en/article/2305037)
- 2026-11-16: RuntimeWire reports the launch of Qwen4-Max with a 1M-token context window and $1.50 input pricing. [RuntimeWire](https://runtimewire.com/article/alibaba-qwen4-max-launch-1m-context-pricing)
- 2026-11-16: A DEV Community post claims Qwen4-Max is a 2.4-trillion-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model. This is unverified. [DEV](https://dev.to/ton_thnhthy_ba110cce85/qwen4-max-is-here-a-24t-parameter-teammate-that-cuts-your-agent-bill-by-62-with-a-catch-3ek1)
- 2026-11-12: Tech Times reported that the preview had no benchmarks, model card or price. [Tech Times](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/330536/20261112/alibaba-qwen4-max-preview-retires-november-25-no-benchmarks-model-card-price.htm)
- 2026-11-11: Alibaba posted "Qwen4 is coming" on X and opened the preview on Token Plan. [X](https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/2120335993643684315)
- I did not find an official Alibaba press release or X post for the Nov 16 general availability. The evidence is the documentation itself plus secondary press.

## 4. Base rates
- Earlier Max models went from preview to a priced pay-as-you-go listing quickly. qwen3.7-max-preview had published prices ($2.5 / $7.5) alongside qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20, which suggests days to weeks between the two. [pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing)
- Once Alibaba lists a model on its pricing pages, it rarely removes it within weeks. Older snapshots such as qwen3.7-max-2026-05-17 are still listed.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "Next Qwen Max (4.1+) released by...": Jan 31 at 0.40 and Mar 31 at 0.845. This market is about a later version, not Qwen4, so it does not match the question.
- Kalshi, "Top Chinese AI Company week of Nov 16": Alibaba 0.11. "Alibaba vs Xiaomi Arena score end of 2026": Alibaba 0.49. Neither is directly relevant.
- I found no market on Qwen4 pay-as-you-go availability itself.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-19: Alibaba reports September-quarter earnings. Qwen4-Max will likely be mentioned. [aktiencheck](https://aktiencheck.de/artikel/alibaba-aktie-quartalszahlen-q2-kann-die-ki-cloud-die-milliardenverluste)
- 2026-11-25, 16:00 UTC: The preview ends. Qwen4-Plus, Flash or 27B listings may also appear around then.
- The main remaining risk is that Alibaba takes down or restricts the qwen4-max listing before Nov 27. Nothing suggests that is happening.

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left and what Yes requires.** About 11.5 days remain, until 23:59 UTC on November 27, 2026. Yes requires that at least one Qwen4 model, with an ID not containing "preview", is listed with standard pay-as-you-go input and output prices on either Model Studio pricing page at that time.

**(b) Status quo.** Both independent research reports say both pricing pages already list **qwen4-max**, updated November 16, 2026:
- International page: $1.5 / $4.5 per million tokens in Singapore, $1.413 / $4.24 in Beijing.
- China page: CNY 10 / 30.
- Both pages also carry cache and batch rows.

If nothing changes, the question resolves Yes.

**(c) Base rate.** The reference class is priced Model Studio listings that get removed within about two weeks of first appearing. That is extremely rare. Alibaba keeps old snapshots such as qwen3.7-max-2026-05-17 listed for months, and shutdowns come with months of notice. Given that a listing exists, persistence over 11 days is about 98-99%.

**(d) Strongest evidence.**
- For Yes:
  - Two independently written reports dated November 16 confirm the qwen4-max listing on both resolution pages, with consistent detailed prices.
  - There is a dedicated qwen4-max doc page and a "Recommended models" entry, both dated November 16.
  - Secondary coverage the same day (AlphaSignal, ChainCatcher, RuntimeWire) says the model is "live now" at $1.50 / $4.50.
  - An official @Alibaba_Qwen "Meet Qwen4-Max" post was seen in a search snippet.
- For No:
  - Neither report could test actual API calls.
  - No full official press release was read.
  - There is a remote chance the listing is pulled or edited, or that a hidden Token Plan-only restriction exists. Report 2 checked only the qwen4 lines; Report 1 searched the page for such notes and found none.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- No: Alibaba discovers the pricing rows were published prematurely, removes qwen4-max from both pages, and reverts to the preview-only status until a December GA. A resolver sees nothing on November 27.
- Yes: The listing simply persists, and qwen4-plus or qwen4-flash rows may be added after November 25.

**(f) From base rate to final probability.** I start from about 98% persistence given the listing exists. I shade slightly for the residual risk that the research misread the pages and for a resolver-interpretation edge case. Since the outcome is essentially already decided, going above 97% is justified, but I hold at about 97% for log-score safety.

Probability: 97%

(a) About 11.5 days remain, until 23:59 UTC on November 27, 2026. For Yes, either Model Studio pricing page (international or China) must, at that time, list a Qwen4 model whose ID lacks "preview" with standard pay-as-you-go input and output prices. Alternatively, credible sources must report that such a model was available on a pay-as-you-go basis before November 28.

(b) If nothing changes, the outcome is Yes. Both research reports independently say that as of November 16, 2026 both pricing pages list qwen4-max:
- International page: $1.5 input / $4.5 output per million tokens in Singapore, and $1.413 / $4.24 in China (Beijing).
- China page: CNY 10 / CNY 30 per million tokens.
- Both pages also carry cache and batch rows for the model.

(c) Base rate: once Alibaba lists a priced model on these pages, it is very rarely pulled within two weeks. Older snapshots such as qwen3.7-max-2026-05-17 are still listed. I estimate about 98% or more of priced listings survive for two weeks.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On November 16, 2026, both pricing pages (updated November 16) list qwen4-max with pay-as-you-go prices.
  - A dedicated qwen4-max documentation page lists Singapore and Beijing deployments.
  - The Recommended models page puts qwen4-max first.
  - AlphaSignal reports it is "Live now on QwenCloud API".
  - ChainCatcher and RuntimeWire report the launch with the same $1.50 price.
  - An official @Alibaba_Qwen "Meet Qwen4-Max" post appeared, though only a search snippet was readable.
- **For No:**
